nodes.text: Golden Friday favorites 🏆 1. fluidity_pour_paints (can not at)- dragon-mode campfire 2. @wildlife_curios - golden tree, own bench 3. @angelo_marcialis_photography - blooms on black 4. @frandoll.fd - Tennessee sunrise stream 5. @1982wildcatfan - swamp mirror autumn 6. @mammakates - gradient sunset 7. jglass8 (can not at) - kiss in the sun 8. @mike___zed - walker at golden hour 9. @allemor.romella - palms, ferry, gold Questions below - answer if you like!
photos: A vibrant bonfire burns in the dark, its yellow and orange flames accented by flashes of bright blue and green. The intense colors dance across stacked logs, creating a cozy and mesmerizing campfire scene.

A large, vibrant autumn tree overflows with golden-orange leaves, casting a warm glow over a wooden park bench nestled beneath its branches. A thick blanket of fallen leaves covers the ground in brilliant shades of yellow, red, and orange, creating a serene and picturesque seasonal scene.

A vertical medium shot captures a bouquet of bright yellow flowers in a white vase against a solid black background. The yellow petals resemble those of sunflowers. The white vase is long and narrow, with a curved design, resembling the shape of an hourglass. The image has a copyright notice in the bottom right corner that reads “© Angelo Marcialis Photography”.
Golden hour light filters through a dense forest canopy, casting a warm, glowing reflection on a serene, shallow creek.

A tall, golden-orange tree stands at the edge of a still body of water, its autumnal colors dramatically mirrored in the surface. The scene is peaceful and rustic, highlighting the vibrant beauty of the changing season.
A serene sunset casts a warm yellow and orange glow across a calm lake, with a distant treeline silhouetted against the horizon.

Captured from across the water, the iconic "Unconditional Surrender" statue in San Diego is silhouetted against a brilliant orange sunset, with the sun perfectly positioned behind the couple. The horizon is filled with warm, golden light and the silhouette of a nearby aircraft carrier.

A solitary figure strolls along a waterfront promenade during a vivid sunset, framed by the dark silhouette of a large tree overhead. In the distance, harbor lights and distant hills glow softly beneath a dramatic sky streaked with orange and yellow hues.

A golden sunset illuminates a scenic marina, casting the silhouettes of several tall palm trees against the bright sky. In the foreground, cars are parked along the waterfront near docked boats, creating a relaxed evening atmosphere.

6/9 @mammakates Distilled to pure gradient - were you going for minimalism or did the sky just hand it to you?
7/9 jglass8 The sun landing right inside the kiss - planned timing or pure luck?
8/9 @mike___zed A lone walker, a lamppost, golden hour - did you wait for the person or were they a gift?

Daily sunset, most of the times, living in Southern California.
